t: This is All Saints in Camden Town, where Camden Street meets Pratt Street. It was built for the Church of England, but today it is the Greek Orthodox Cathedral Church of All Saints. The man who designed it was William Inwood, an English architect and surveyor. Inwood is best known for St Pancras New Church and Westminster Hospital, work he did together with his sons. So this building belongs to a family practice that left its mark on this part of London.
